title: Dying Gives OP Items
description: Every time you die, you drop overpowered loot instead of losing everything. Turn your deaths into an absolute jackpot and try to beat the game!
body:
## What is this project even about?

We’ve all been there: you make one tiny mistake, slip into lava, or get blindsided by a Creeper, and boom—hours of progress gone. It’s frustrating. 

So, I decided to flip that entirely on its head. Instead of punishing you for messing up, **Dying is OP** turns every single death into an absolute jackpot. The moment you die, the game rewards your "failure" by dropping an explosion of ridiculously overpowered, top-tier survival loot right at your feet. It’s perfect for chaotic survival runs, "Minecraft But..." style videos, or just messing around with friends.

## 🧩 What you need to know before installing

* **Citizens is Required:** Because of how the backend handles entity interactions, you **must** have the Citizens plugin installed on your server for this to work. You can grab the correct build from their official Spigot or Jenkins pages.
* **Server Setup:** Just toss it into your server's `plugins` folder alongside Citizens, give the server a quick restart, and you're good to go.

## 🎥 For Content Creators (Youtubers / Streamers)

We love seeing people use my work in videos! If you’re a creator and you use this plugin for a challenge or a series, I just ask for one small favor:

Please include the official links to this page in your video description. It helps support my work and lets your viewers find the plugin easily. To avoid copyright, include the official links to this page in your video description.

## Quick Start Guide

1. Grab the latest `.jar` file from the Versions tab.
2. Make sure you already have **Citizens** in your server's `plugins` folder.
3. Drop our `DyingGivesOPItems` file right in there with it.
4. Restart your server, jump in, and go find a way to die to get your first jackpot!
